raw_segments.text: Cadmus, O depth of grief, how can I fathom thee or look upon thee, poor, poor, blood-stained
Poor sisters, a fair sacrifice to stand before God's altars, daughter, yea, and call me
and my citizens to feast with all.
Nay, let me weep for thine affliction most, then for mine own.
All all of us are lost, not wrongfully, yet is it hard, from one who might have loved
